correctness.rationale: Fix an edge set H carrying label 2 in K_n. The set C of its endpoints must support a graph with no isolated vertices, and every edge among the remaining r=n-|C| vertices is forced to label 1. Choosing C in binom(n,c), the no-isolate graph supports in A_{c,k}, and freely assigning 0/1 to M-k-binom(r,2) remaining edges yields the exact displayed sum plus the no-2 all-ones contribution z^M. The lower bound 2 ceil((n-r)/2)+binom(r,2) has unique extremal r=1 odd and r=2 even, giving matching minima with counts n(n-2)!! and binom(n,2)(n-3)!!. Independently enumerated every label n=3..5 and all minima n=3..12. The proof establishes n>=5, experiments do not generalize it.

value.rationale: Every coefficient of an established domination polynomial for a canonical infinite Johnson-graph family is a natural invariant and the complete equality-case classification explains the parity-dependent set of minima. The result is not a recomputation of the known scalar optimum or a finite arbitrary slice.

limitations: The all-n>=5 formula counts labeled RDFs, not automorphism orbits; no result for higher Johnson J(n,k).
